--- title: "Alzheimer's disease GWAS — interactive colocalization Manhattan plot" format: html: embed-resources: true page-layout: full toc: false execute: echo: false warning: false message: false --- ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## How to use Hover your mouse in any variant of a significant locus: **all variants of that locus will turn red** and the box will show the summary of colocalization of that locus. Double-click to clear the highlight. For busiest regions you can use the zoom tool to help separate the labels. The background points are variants outside the colocalization windows and are not interactive. To keep the scale legible, the plot shows only variants with **p < 1e-4** and the y axis was truncated on the top because of APOE locus. ::: ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
